sky-rule.note: Alpha hairline on sky; chart grid lines use rgb(243 241 234 / 0.12).

display.purpose: His given name in the opening plate only; italic, upright in Hebrew.

title.purpose: Family name, "We'll dance again.", quotations, closing line, Book form heading.

label.purpose: Dates, captions, counts, attributions, language links, footer. Letter-spacing 0 in Hebrew.

numeral.purpose: The candle count, min-width 4ch so it changes in place.

motion.name: ease-calm
motion.purpose: Color transitions and the image fade-in.

motion.name: image-fade
motion.value: opacity 450ms ease-calm; CSS fallback shows the image after 3s
motion.purpose: Plates fade in once loaded; no transition under reduced motion.

motion.name: star-born
motion.value: 1200ms ease-out; scale 0.4 to 1, amber drop-shadow peaking at 6px then clearing

breakpoints.name: wide
breakpoints.purpose: 12-column chapter and opening grid; below it everything stacks.

components.name: Candle Button
components.description: The live candle on a sky plate; amber outline, fills on hover, never toggles off once lit.
components.css: .ds-sky { background: var(--sky, #22314F); padding: 24px; } .ds-btn-candle { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 24px; background: transparent; color: var(--amber, #E3B062); border: 1px solid var(--amber, #E3B062); border-radius: 2px; font-family: 'Assistant Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.0625rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.25,0.1,0.25,1), color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.25,0.1,0.25,1), transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-btn-candle:hover { background: var(--amber, #E3B062); color: var(--sky, #22314F); } .ds-btn-candle:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--amber, #E3B062); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-candle:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-candle:disabled { cursor: default; border-color: rgb(243 241 234 / 0.2); color: var(--fog, #A7B3CC); background: transparent; }

components.name: Ink Button
components.description: The Book of Memories submit on paper.
components.css: .ds-btn-ink { min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 32px; background: var(--ink, #19213A); color: var(--paper, #F1F3F4); border: 1px solid var(--ink, #19213A); border-radius: 2px; font-family: 'Assistant Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.0625rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.25,0.1,0.25,1), transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-btn-ink:hover { background: var(--sky, #22314F); } .ds-btn-ink:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink, #19213A); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-ink:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-ink:disabled { opacity: 0.6; cursor: progress; }

components.name: Music Player
components.description: Fixed bottom inline-end toggle for the song.
components.css: .ds-btn-player { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 16px; background: var(--sky, #22314F); color: var(--chalk, #F3F1EA); border: 1px solid rgb(243 241 234 / 0.2); border-radius: 2px; font-family: 'Assistant Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; letter-spacing: 0.06em; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-btn-player:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--amber, #E3B062); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-player:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Book of Memories field with a sans label above.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; max-width: 420px; } .ds-field span { font-family: 'Assistant Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; letter-spacing: 0.02em; color: var(--ink-2, #4A5470); } .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 12px 16px; background: #FFFFFF; color: var(--ink, #19213A); border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #737B90); border-radius: 2px; font-family: 'Source Serif 4 Variable', Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.0625rem; line-height: 1.5; caret-color: var(--amber-ink, #7A4E0E); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink, #19213A); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-input[aria-invalid='true'] { border-color: var(--amber-ink, #7A4E0E); }

components.name: Language Links
components.description: Languages as words in the coordinate voice, on the opening sky plate.
components.html: EnglishPortuguêsעברית
components.css: .ds-langs { display: flex; gap: 24px; padding: 16px 24px; background: var(--sky, #22314F); font-family: 'Assistant Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; letter-spacing: 0.06em; } .ds-langs a { color: var(--fog, #A7B3CC); text-decoration: none; padding-block: 8px; text-underline-offset: 0.2em; } .ds-langs a[aria-current='page'] { color: var(--chalk, #F3F1EA); text-decoration: underline; } .ds-langs a:hover { color: var(--chalk, #F3F1EA); } .ds-langs a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--amber, #E3B062); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Paper Plate
components.description: A photograph mounted on chalk paper: mat, hairline, two diamond terminals, coordinate caption.
components.css: .ds-plate { margin: 0; padding: 24px; background: var(--paper, #F1F3F4); max-width: 360px; } .ds-plate-frame { position: relative; background: var(--paper-2, #E4E8EB); padding: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--rule, #C7CAD3); } .ds-plate-frame::before, .ds-plate-frame::after { content: ''; position: absolute; width: 7px; height: 7px; background: var(--paper, #F1F3F4); border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #737B90); transform: rotate(45deg); } .ds-plate-frame::before { top: -4px; left: -4px; } .ds-plate-frame::after { bottom: -4px; right: -4px; } .ds-plate-img { aspect-ratio: 4 / 3; background: #B9C0C9; } .ds-plate figcaption { margin-top: 12px; color: var(--ink-2, #4A5470); font-family: 'Assistant Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; letter-spacing: 0.06em; }

components.name: Sky Plate with Star Chart
components.description: Dusk plate with an inset frame and diamonds; chalk stars on the magnitude ramp; the amber ring marks your star.
components.css: .ds-sky-plate { position: relative; background: var(--sky, #22314F); padding: 40px; } .ds-frame { position: absolute; inset: 16px; border: 1px solid rgb(243 241 234 / 0.2); pointer-events: none; } .ds-frame::before, .ds-frame::after, .ds-chart::before, .ds-chart::after { content: ''; position: absolute; width: 7px; height: 7px; background: var(--sky, #22314F); border: 1px solid var(--fog, #A7B3CC); transform: rotate(45deg); } .ds-frame::before, .ds-chart::before { top: -4px; left: -4px; } .ds-frame::after, .ds-chart::after { bottom: -4px; right: -4px; } .ds-chart { position: relative; background: var(--sky-2, #1B2842); border: 1px solid rgb(243 241 234 / 0.2); } .ds-chart svg { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; } .ds-chart line { stroke: rgb(243 241 234 / 0.12); stroke-dasharray: 2 7; } .ds-chart .s { fill: var(--chalk, #F3F1EA); } .ds-chart .ring { fill: none; stroke: var(--amber, #E3B062); stroke-width: 1.5; }

narrative.overview:
The page is a star atlas of the sky he danced under. Cool chalk paper carries the reading; framed dusk chart-blue plates carry the sky. The sky never floods the page: it appears only as bounded plates (the opening plate and the candle chart), each set in from its edge by a hairline frame with diamond terminals, the way a printed atlas mounts its charts. Nothing is night-black, nothing is heavy. The family asked for a memorial that is not dark, and the system holds that line through a light paper ground and a dusk (not midnight) blue.

Two voices share the type. A variable serif tells the story and carries his name in a large italic; a clean sans in tabular, lining figures sets everything that behaves like a coordinate: dates, counts, captions, language links, attributions. Stars are chalk-white on a fixed five-step magnitude ramp, placed deterministically so every visitor sees the same sky and a new candle never moves the others. Candle amber is the only warm color, and it belongs to the live candle.

Motion is almost absent. Images fade in once loaded; in-page links scroll smoothly; the star birth is the one authored moment. Nothing reveals on scroll.
keyCharacteristics: Light chalk paper ground with framed dusk-blue sky plates; never night-black.
Hairline frames with two diamond terminals on opposite corners mark every plate.
Serif for story, tabular sans for coordinates.
One warm accent (candle amber) reserved for the live candle object.
Square plates, 2px corners on controls only.
One authored motion moment: the star birth.
Three languages, Hebrew right-to-left and never slanted.

rules.name: The One Live Object Rule
rules.body: Candle amber marks the live candle and its consequences (button, "your star" ring, legend, candle error) and focus on sky. "We'll dance again.", the plate diamonds, headings and links are never amber. If amber appears anywhere a visitor cannot light a candle or is not focused, it is wrong.

rules.name: The Dusk, Not Night Rule
rules.body: The sky is dusk chart-blue, used only as framed plates set into chalk paper. No full-bleed dark sections beyond a plate, no black, no dark mode.

rules.name: The Coordinates Rule
rules.body: Anything that is a date, a count, a place-caption or a navigation word is set in the sans with tabular lining figures. Story and names are serif.

rules.name: The Upright Hebrew Rule
rules.body: Hebrew never slants. Every italic role (his name, "We'll dance again.", quotations, the closing line, candle and form headings, signer names, the thank-you note) is set `font-style: normal` under `:lang(he)`. Coordinate letter-spacing also drops to 0 in Hebrew.

rules.name: The Place, Not Year Rule
rules.body: Captions state place and topic ("Porto Alegre · Grêmio", "At the drums"), never invented years or ages.

rules.name: The Mounted, Not Lifted Rule
rules.body: Things are framed, never floated. Separate surfaces with a hairline and a mat, not a shadow.

dos: Do mount every plate (photo, portrait, chart) in a 1px hairline frame with an 8px mat and two diamond terminals on opposite corners.
Do keep the sky to framed dusk-blue (#22314F) plates set into chalk paper (#F1F3F4).
Do set dates, counts, captions and navigation in the Assistant sans with tabular lining figures.
Do reset every italic role to `font-style: normal` under `:lang(he)`, and use logical properties (`inset-inline-*`, `padding-inline-*`) so Hebrew mirrors.
Do keep the star birth the only authored animation, and gate it behind `prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference`.
Do write captions as place and topic.
Do keep touch targets at 44–48px minimum.
donts: Don't use candle amber for anything other than the live candle object and focus on sky: not for "We'll dance again.", not for diamonds, headings or links.
Don't use black, night-black sections or a dark full-page ground.
Don't add box shadows; mount surfaces with hairlines and mats instead.
Don't add scroll reveals or entrance animations beyond the image fade-in.
Don't let Hebrew slant, and don't letter-space Hebrew coordinates.
Don't invent years or ages in captions.
Don't enlarge a photo past its natural size.
